title: Computer Networks
description: OSI and TCP/IP protocol stacks, socket programming, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and network security.

nodes.title: Network Models & Physical Layer
nodes.description: OSI 7-layer reference model, TCP/IP stack, bandwith, latency, and transmission media.

children.title: OSI Model vs TCP/IP Model
children.description: 7 layers of OSI vs 4 layers of TCP/IP, encapsulation and decapsulation.

children.title: Data Link Layer & MAC Addressing
children.description: Framing, Ethernet protocols, MAC addresses, ARP (Address Resolution Protocol).

nodes.title: Network Layer & IP Routing
nodes.description: IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, NAT, ICMP, and routing algorithms (OSPF, BGP).

children.title: IP Addressing & Subnetting (CIDR)
children.description: Classful vs Classless (CIDR) addressing, subnet masks, IP range calculation.

children.title: Routing Protocols (Distance Vector & Link State)
children.description: Dijkstra link state (OSPF) vs Bellman-Ford distance vector (RIP), BGP peering.

nodes.title: Transport Layer (TCP & UDP)
nodes.description: 3-Way Handshake, TCP flow control (Sliding Window), congestion control, and UDP sockets.

children.title: TCP 3-Way Handshake & Connection Termination
children.description: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, FIN-WAIT, TIME-WAIT states, sequence numbers.

children.title: TCP Flow Control & Congestion Control
children.description: Sliding window, Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, Fast Recovery.

nodes.title: Application Layer & Protocols
nodes.description: DNS hierarchy, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, TLS/SSL handshake, WebSockets.

children.title: DNS Lookup & Domain Resolution
children.description: Recursive vs iterative DNS queries, root servers, TLDs, A/AAAA/CNAME records.

children.title: HTTP, HTTPS & TLS Handshake
children.description: HTTP request/response headers, status codes, TLS 1.3 asymmetric encryption handshake.
